title: Right Turn Scan: Pedestrian and Bicyclist at the Corner
handbookSource: California Driver’s Handbook · Section 7 · Right-of-Way Rules · Turning right; Pedestrians. https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/handbook/california-driver-handbook/laws-and-rules-of-the-road/ (checked 2026-10-15; final human review pending)
learnerPrompt: You want to turn right on green. When do you go?

choices.label: Turn while the light is green

safeOutcome: You wait for both the person and bicyclist, check again, then turn right.
unsafeOutcome: Green did not clear your turn’s path. Wait for the person and the bicyclist.
